summary: Intercont (Cayman) Ltd filed a Form 6-K reporting the pricing and closing of a best-efforts public offering of 8,000,000 units at $0.79/unit, each consisting of one Class A ordinary share and one warrant (exercise price $0.869, six-month term), for gross proceeds of ~$6.32 million. Prime Number Capital acted as placement agent, receiving a 5% cash fee and 1% expense allowance. Officers, directors, and certain existing shareholders signed 180-day lock-up agreements. Net proceeds will be used for working capital and general corporate purposes. This is a routine equity financing, not a special situation.
